signal.headline: SGD rates expected to ease before quarter end

whyClient: SGD 380,000 fixed deposit maturing in 12 days — currently his only rate-locked instrument.
whyNow: The desk expects SGD rates to ease before the renewal date. Left alone, the deposit rolls over automatically at whatever rate applies on 2026-09-26.
whyInstrument: A short-tenor structured deposit locks today's rate ahead of the move, without extending duration.
narrative: The desk expects SGD short-term rates to ease by about a quarter point before quarter end. Chen's SGD 380,000 fixed deposit is his only rate-locked instrument and matures on 26 September, right in that window — left alone, it rolls over automatically at whatever lower rate applies. A short call before then locks in today's rate with a new structured deposit.

signal.headline: Foundry-segment guidance cut ~8% across peer set

whyClient: 42% of her portfolio sits in one foundry-segment name — well past the 30% concentration threshold for her mandate.
whyNow: A sector-wide guidance cut published this morning directly touches the held name; relevance to this conversation decays fast as the news ages.
whyInstrument: A discretionary-mandate rebalance conversation, not a sale recommendation — the point is to discuss the concentration, not to pitch a product.
narrative: A guidance cut of roughly 8% was published this morning across the foundry segment. 42% of Priya's portfolio sits in a single foundry-segment holding — already well past her 30% concentration guideline — so this lands directly on her largest position and raises how much a single bad quarter could cost her. Worth a discretionary-mandate conversation about the concentration itself, not a sale recommendation.

signal.headline: SGD rates expected to ease before quarter end

whyClient: SGD 250,000 corporate bond maturing in 17 days.
whyNow: Same rate move as above: reinvesting after the move, rather than before, risks a lower running yield on the replacement instrument.
whyInstrument: A comparable-tenor bond, reinvested ahead of the rate move.
narrative: The same SGD rate-easing move expected this quarter also affects Michael's SGD 250,000 corporate bond, maturing in 17 days ahead of when the move is expected to land. Reinvesting after the move, rather than before it, risks a lower running yield — worth flagging with enough lead time to reinvest into a comparable-tenor bond first.

Worth a review call to size an income-oriented fund allocation against how much of the balance she actually wants deployed.
